gig.text: DMA'S outdoors in summer is about as good as Aussie guitar music gets. Big, simple choruses that were made for a crowd on the grass with a drink in hand. If you're in Melbourne and haven't sorted your Saturday yet, sort it.

record.title: Blue
record.text: One of those records everyone should own on vinyl. Ten songs, no filler, and it sounds beautiful on a decent turntable. The new limited blue pressing is as good an excuse as any if you've been putting it off.
